name: drop
description: Publish plans, docs, pages and small apps to Drop as a link people review and comment on, read their comments, and publish the next version. Adds Drop's MCP server and its skills.

interface.longDescription: Your agent publishes its plan, page, or app to Drop and sends you a link. You comment on the exact spot, and it reads the comments and publishes the next version. The skills cover pull request evidence, prototypes, data dashboards, handoffs, slides, and lessons.
defaultPrompt: Publish this plan to Drop so I can comment on it.
Read the comments on my last drop and publish the next version.
